isan.name: Isan
isan.about: The Lao-related speech of Thailand's northeast, heard all over Bangkok from taxi and win motorsai drivers, som tam cooks and builders who came from Khon Kaen, Udon or Ubon.

never_mind: Never mind, it's fine (ไม่เป็นไร)
how_much: How much is it? (เท่าไหร่ครับ)
Can you knock a bit off? (ลดหน่อยได้ไหมคะ)
delicious: Very tasty (อร่อยมาก)

hello: Hello, are you well? (สบายดีบ่)
how_are_you: Where have you been? (ไปไสมา)
Eaten yet? (กินข้าวแล้วบ่)
fine: I'm fine (สบายดีอยู่)
thanks: Thanks a lot (ขอบใจหลายๆ)
sorry: Never mind (บ่เป็นหยัง)
bye: I'm off, OK? (ไปก่อนเด้อ)
delicious: Really tasty (แซ่บหลาย)

greet: Morning! The BTS was packed today.
Hi there, how's your day going?
reply: All good, just a bit hot.
sunny: So hot today, I need a cha yen.
The sun is fierce, walk in the shade.
Clear sky, good day for the river.
Nice and sunny, Lumphini will be busy later.
rain: Take an umbrella, it will pour soon.
Rain like this means the traffic will not move.
Wait it out, it usually stops in half an hour.
busy: Sorry, I'm late for a meeting.
Traffic was terrible, I have to run.
Can't stop, my Grab is here.
I need to catch the next skytrain, sorry!

greet: Sawatdee kha, kin khao rue yang?
Sawatdee kha Phi, wan ni pen yangngai bang?
reply: Kin laeo khrap, laeo Khun la?
Mai pen rai, sabai dee khrap.
sunny: Ron jang, kin cha yen kan mai?
Fa sai dee na wan ni.
rain: Ao rom pai duay na kha.
Fon tok yang ni, rot tit nae loei.
bye: Dulae tua eng duay na kha.
busy: Kho thot khrap, rip mak loei.
Rot tit mak, sai laeo kha.
Wai khoi khui gan na kha.

reply: Sabaidee yu, khop jai lai lai.
sunny: Hon lai, kin nam kon der.
busy: Bo mi wela, pai kon der.

touts: Rangsit, Rangsit! Rot tu, khuen loei!
Mo Chit, Mo Chit, khuen loei khrap!
Sanam Luang, Sanam Luang, mi thi nang khrap!
Tha Chang, Tha Chang! Rua ok laeo!
hawkers: Mu ping, mai la sip baht kha!
Grilled pork skewers, ten baht a stick!
Thai iced tea, iced lime tea!
Luk chin ping, mai la sip!
small_talk: The BTS was packed at Siam this morning.
Traffic on Sukhumvit did not move for an hour.
Rainy season, the storm comes at four every afternoon.
Let's get boat noodles near Victory Monument.
Chatuchak this weekend? Go early before it gets hot.
Songkran is coming, keep your phone in a plastic bag.
The soi flooded again after last night's storm.
Grab is surging, I'll just take a win motorsai.
There's a new coffee place in Ari, half the startups work from there.
Hot season is no joke, it's forty degrees by noon.
The som tam lady at the end of the soi has the best one.
